newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NAIL RENEWS CAUTIONARY ON GOLD FIELDS TALKS.
newsitem.headline: NAIL RENEWS CAUTIONARY ON GOLD FIELDS TALKS.

text.p: Black South African investment group New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) said on Friday it was still in talks with Gold Fields of South Africa and Driefontein that could effect its share price.
The firm urged shareholders to use caution when dealing in its shares. Gold Fields and Driefontein also renewed cautionary notices on their shares.
Nail first announced in May that it was in discussions with Gold Fields and its Driefontein unit over acquiring their shareholdings in Asteroid Ltd, which holds 40 percent of GFSA Holdings Ltd.

The deal, if successful, would mark a further big advance for black business in South Africa -- and a significant coup for Nail which already has control of industrial group Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd.
Gold Fields is the world's third biggest gold producer.
